products.name: Financial Research and Analytics Platform (SentimenTrader.com)
products.description: A subscription-based digital platform providing proprietary research analytics, sentiment indicators, backtesting tools, and actionable trading strategies for institutional and retail equity and options traders. Delivered via web interface and email, it combines AI-driven technology with human analyst expertise.

products.name: Market Data and Technology Tools (DataEdge API, Indicators & Charts, Backtest Engine)
products.description: A suite of digital tools including APIs for raw data access, proprietary sentiment indicators and charts, and a no-code backtesting engine, enabling users to integrate, analyze, and simulate trading strategies using historical and real-time market data. Delivered via web and API, targeting both individuals and institutional clients.

products.name: Research Reports and Market Analysis
products.description: Regularly published digital research reports and market analyses covering equities, options, commodities, and bonds, authored by in-house analysts and distributed via email and platform access. Includes daily and weekly reports such as SentimentEdge, Kaeppel’s Corner, ModelEdge, and TradingEdge Weekly.

products.name: Actionable Trading Strategy Tools (Smart Stock Scanner, Macro Index Trading Strategies)
products.description: Digital tools and models that scan, rank, and simulate stock and ETF trading opportunities using AI and historical data, including pre-built macro index trading strategies for various market conditions. Delivered via the SentimenTrader platform to subscribers.

products.name: Investor Newsletters (Alpha Edge Media/AEM)
products.description: A portfolio of digital newsletters targeting institutional and retail investors, offering AI-driven, data-informed insights on macroeconomic trends, equities, crypto, IPOs, and small-cap stocks. Distributed via email and web, with both free and paid subscription models.

products.name: Digital Asset Market Intelligence (21Bitcoin.xyz)
products.description: A digital platform that autonomously generates and distributes real-time market intelligence on digital assets, blockchain, DeFi, NFTs, and related trends using an AI-powered publishing engine. Content is delivered online to institutional and retail readers.

products.name: Investor Community and Sentiment Platform (Stockcastr)
products.description: A community-driven digital platform where subscribers share and aggregate short-term price forecasts for mega-cap stocks, generating a Community Sentiment indicator accessible to all members.

products.name: Investor Events and Summits (Alpha Edge Summit)
products.description: Organization and hosting of global events and summits for digital asset leaders, investors, and innovators, providing networking, education, and brand engagement opportunities. Events are designed for scalability and strategic impact.

products.name: Intelligent Content Management Platform (Box ICM)
products.description: A cloud-based Software-as-a-Service platform that enables organizations to securely manage, collaborate on, and govern the entire lifecycle of unstructured content, including storage, sharing, editing, publishing, approval, e-signature, classification, and retention. Delivered digitally via web, desktop, and mobile applications, with enterprise-grade security, compliance, and integration with over 1,500 business applications.

products.name: Box Platform (Content Platform-as-a-Service)
products.description: A developer-focused Platform-as-a-Service offering that provides APIs and developer tools for IT teams and third-party developers to build custom content-centric applications and integrations, extending Box’s core content management, security, and AI capabilities into other business applications and workflows.

products.name: Box AI Platform and AI Services
products.description: A suite of advanced AI-powered features and APIs integrated into the Box platform, enabling intelligent document processing, content summarization, metadata extraction, workflow automation, and the creation of custom AI agents, all delivered digitally with enterprise-grade security and privacy.

products.name: Box Shield and Box Shield Pro (Security and Threat Protection)
products.description: Advanced security and threat detection solutions that provide real-time malware scanning, AI-driven threat analysis, data classification, and granular access controls to protect content and prevent data breaches, delivered as part of the Box platform.

products.name: Box Governance (Data Governance and Compliance)
products.description: A compliance and data governance solution that enables organizations to manage content retention, legal holds, and regulatory compliance, with integrations to eDiscovery vendors, delivered as a digital service within the Box platform.

products.name: Box Shuttle (Content Migration Services)
products.description: A content migration tool and associated consulting services that enable organizations to move large-scale data from legacy systems to Box, including analysis, simulation, and managed migration, delivered digitally and via professional services.

products.name: Box Archive (Long-term Content Archival)
products.description: A long-term, compliant content preservation solution built on the Box platform, providing secure, immutable, and highly available storage for inactive data, with rapid retrieval compared to traditional cold storage.

products.name: Box Sign (Electronic Signature)
products.description: A natively integrated e-signature solution that enables secure, compliant electronic signing workflows for contracts and documents, with support for templates, authentication, and regulatory compliance, available via web, mobile, and APIs.

products.name: Box Relay (Workflow Automation)
products.description: A no-code process automation tool for building, managing, and tracking content-centric workflows, enabling users to automate document routing, approvals, and metadata management within the Box platform.

products.name: Box Apps and Box Forms (No-Code Application and Form Builder)
products.description: No-code tools that allow users to create custom business applications, dashboards, and web/mobile forms for data collection and workflow integration, delivered as part of the Box platform.

products.name: Box Notes and Box Canvas (Collaboration and Content Authoring Tools)
products.description: Native tools for real-time content authoring, note-taking, and visual collaboration (whiteboarding), enabling teams to co-author, brainstorm, and organize content within the Box platform, accessible via web and mobile.

products.name: Box Hubs (Intelligent Content Portals)
products.description: A solution for creating secure, centralized content portals for publishing and sharing curated content across organizations, with governance and compliance controls, delivered digitally within Box.

products.name: Professional Services (Box Consulting)
products.description: Consulting and implementation services, including migration, deployment, and industry-specific solution configuration, delivered by Box Consulting and partners to help customers maximize value from Box products.

products.name: Office Property Leasing
products.description: Leasing of office space in owned and partially owned properties, primarily in Manhattan, Chicago, and San Francisco. This involves physical real estate assets managed and maintained by the company, delivered through long-term leases to business tenants.

products.name: Retail Property Leasing
products.description: Leasing of street-level retail space in owned properties, mainly in Manhattan and select other markets. This is delivered through physical real estate assets and long-term leases to retail tenants.

products.name: Residential Property Leasing
products.description: Leasing of residential units in owned apartment buildings, primarily in Manhattan and Queens. This involves physical residential real estate assets managed and maintained by the company, delivered through leases to individual tenants.

products.name: Building Maintenance and Security Services
products.description: Provision of cleaning, security, engineering, and parking services to both Vornado-owned properties and third-party clients, delivered through in-person human labor via a wholly owned subsidiary.

products.name: Signage Leasing
products.description: Leasing of advertising signage space in high-traffic areas such as the PENN District and Times Square, delivered through physical infrastructure and regulated by local ordinances.

products.name: Real Estate Development and Redevelopment Services
products.description: Development and redevelopment of office, retail, and studio properties, including ground-up construction and major renovations, delivered through project management and capital investment. These projects are sometimes conducted via joint ventures.

products.name: Protective Enclosures
products.description: Standard and custom protective enclosures designed and manufactured to protect electronics, systems, and data in mission critical applications. These are physically manufactured products delivered to customers globally, often tailored for specific needs.

products.name: Cooling Solutions (Liquid and Air)
products.description: Liquid and air cooling solutions engineered and manufactured to maintain optimal temperatures for sensitive equipment and systems, particularly in data centers and other mission critical environments. Delivered as physical systems, often integrated with enclosures.

products.name: Control Buildings
products.description: Engineered control building solutions manufactured to house and protect critical infrastructure assets, including electrical and data systems, for utilities and data centers. Delivered as large, prefabricated structures.

products.name: Switchgear and Power Distribution Systems
products.description: Switchgear systems and power distribution solutions designed and manufactured to manage and distribute electrical power safely and reliably in infrastructure and industrial settings. Delivered as physical equipment, often integrated with other protection solutions.

products.name: Bus Systems
products.description: Bus systems designed and manufactured for efficient electrical power distribution in commercial, industrial, and infrastructure applications. Delivered as physical electrical components and assemblies.

products.name: Cable Management Solutions
products.description: Cable management products and systems designed and manufactured to organize, secure, and protect electrical and data cables in various environments. Delivered as physical products for installation by contractors and electricians.

products.name: Electrical Connectors and Connections
products.description: A broad range of electrical connectors and connection solutions manufactured for safe and efficient joining of electrical circuits, used in power and data infrastructure. Delivered as physical components to contractors, utilities, and OEMs.

products.name: Equipment Protection Solutions
products.description: Products and systems designed and manufactured to protect mission critical equipment from environmental, electrical, and physical hazards. Delivered as physical solutions, often integrated with enclosures and cooling systems.

products.name: Power Management Solutions
products.description: Power management products and systems designed and manufactured to optimize, monitor, and control electrical power usage and distribution. Delivered as physical and possibly digital solutions for infrastructure and industrial customers.

products.name: Tools and Test Instruments for Electrical Applications
products.description: Tools and test instruments designed and manufactured for installation, maintenance, and testing of electrical systems. Delivered as physical products to electricians, contractors, and utilities.

products.name: Bitcoin Mining
products.description: CleanSpark operates large-scale, company-owned data centers that use specialized mining servers (ASICs) and significant power infrastructure to mine bitcoin, earning revenue through mining rewards and transaction fees. The process requires physical infrastructure, energy procurement, and ongoing equipment maintenance.

products.name: AI and HPC Hosting Services
products.description: CleanSpark develops and operates data centers designed to host and lease high-performance computing (HPC) and artificial intelligence (AI) workloads for external customers, leveraging its expertise in power optimization, engineering, and large-scale infrastructure. These services involve physical data center construction, power management, and specialized cooling solutions.

products.name: Bispecific T Cell Engager Therapies for Autoimmune Diseases
products.description: Therapies based on bispecific T cell engagers (such as CLN-978 and velinotamig) designed to redirect T cells to deplete pathogenic B cells or plasma cells in autoimmune diseases. These are biologic drugs manufactured using recombinant protein technology and delivered via injection, requiring regulated clinical development and manufacturing infrastructure.

products.name: Bispecific T Cell Engager Therapies for Acute Myeloid Leukemia and Myelodysplastic Syndrome
products.description: Biologic therapies (such as CLN-049) using bispecific T cell engagers to target FLT3 on leukemic cells and CD3 on T cells, enabling T cell-mediated killing of cancer cells in AML and MDS. These are manufactured using recombinant antibody technology and administered intravenously in clinical settings.

products.name: EGFR Inhibitor Therapy for Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
products.description: An orally available small-molecule therapy (zipalertinib) designed to irreversibly inhibit mutant EGFR, specifically targeting NSCLC patients with EGFR exon 20 insertion mutations. This product is chemically synthesized and delivered as an oral tablet, requiring pharmaceutical manufacturing and regulatory approval.

products.name: Tommy Hilfiger Apparel and Accessories
products.description: Design, sourcing, marketing, and sale of men's, women's, and kids' sportswear, denim, underwear, swimwear, accessories, and footwear under the TOMMY HILFIGER and TOMMY JEANS brands. Products are manufactured by third-party suppliers and distributed globally through wholesale, retail stores, and digital commerce.

products.name: Calvin Klein Apparel and Accessories
products.description: Design, sourcing, marketing, and sale of men's and women's sportswear, jeanswear, underwear, swimwear, footwear, and accessories under the Calvin Klein, Calvin Klein Jeans, Calvin Klein Underwear, Calvin Klein Sport, and Calvin Klein Collection brands. Products are manufactured by third-party suppliers and distributed globally through wholesale, retail stores, and digital commerce.

products.name: Tommy Hilfiger Licensed Lifestyle Products
products.description: Licensing of the TOMMY HILFIGER brand for a broad range of lifestyle products including eyewear, watches, jewelry, fragrance, luggage, and tailored clothing. Licensees manufacture and distribute these products under PVH oversight.

products.name: Calvin Klein Licensed Lifestyle Products
products.description: Licensing of the Calvin Klein brand for a broad range of lifestyle products including fragrance, home furnishings, eyewear, watches, jewelry, luggage, and tailored clothing. Licensees manufacture and distribute these products under PVH oversight.

products.name: Heritage Brands Apparel
products.description: Design, sourcing, marketing, and sale of men's underwear under the Nike brand and men's dress shirts under Van Heusen and other licensed brands. Products are manufactured by third-party suppliers and distributed primarily through wholesale channels.

products.name: Women's Apparel
products.description: J.Jill designs and sells women's apparel, including casual and refined clothing for work, travel, loungewear, events, and premium casual occasions. Products are manufactured using high quality fabrics and techniques, offered in a wide range of sizes, and delivered through both physical retail stores and a robust ecommerce platform.

products.name: Footwear
products.description: J.Jill offers women's footwear designed to complement its apparel lines, available in stores and online. Footwear is integrated into seasonal collections and is manufactured to match the brand's style and comfort standards.

products.name: Accessories
products.description: J.Jill sells a range of women's accessories, including jewelry, bags, belts, shoes, and scarves, designed to elevate and complement its apparel offerings. Accessories are available in stores and online, and are included in seasonal merchandise collections.

products.name: Make-Your-Own Stuffed Animals
products.description: Interactive retail and e-commerce experience where customers create personalized stuffed animals by selecting, stuffing, dressing, accessorizing, and naming plush toys, delivered through physical stores and digital platforms.

products.name: Pre-Stuffed Plush Toys and Accessories
products.description: Sale of pre-stuffed plush toys, clothing, shoes, sounds, scents, and a variety of accessories, available in stores and online, manufactured from high-quality materials and distributed globally.

products.name: Licensed Character and Branded Merchandise
products.description: Plush toys, collectibles, and accessories featuring licensed characters and brands from entertainment, sports, art, and gaming properties, sold through retail, e-commerce, and partner channels.

products.name: Gift and Collectible Merchandise
products.description: Specialty plush, collectibles, and gift-oriented products designed for gifting occasions and collectors, available through stores and digital channels, often featuring exclusive or limited-edition items.

products.name: Outbound Licensing of Build-A-Bear Brand and IP
products.description: Licensing Build-A-Bear intellectual property and brand to third-party manufacturers for non-plush consumer categories, generating royalty revenue from branded products produced and sold by partners.

products.name: Wholesale Distribution to Third-Party Retailers
products.description: Wholesale sales of Build-A-Bear products to third-party retailers and partner-operated stores, who then execute the Build-A-Bear retail experience or sell products under wholesale agreements.

products.name: Birthday Parties and Group Events
products.description: In-store and digital group experiences for birthdays and special occasions, where guests participate in the Build-A-Bear creation process as part of a party or event package.

products.name: Build-A-Bear Entertainment Content
products.description: Creation and distribution of digital and physical entertainment content (short-form and long-form) for kids and adults, leveraging Build-A-Bear intellectual property to engage consumers and drive brand affinity.

products.name: BNC210 (for Social Anxiety Disorder and Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder)
products.description: An orally administered, proprietary small molecule negative allosteric modulator of the α7 nicotinic acetylcholine receptor, developed for both acute and chronic treatment of social anxiety disorder (SAD) and post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD). Manufactured via synthetic chemistry and delivered as a tablet formulation, BNC210 is intended for outpatient use and is advancing through late-stage clinical trials.

products.name: α7 Receptor Positive Allosteric Modulator Program (licensed to Merck)
products.description: A portfolio of small molecule positive allosteric modulators (PAMs) of the α7 nicotinic acetylcholine receptor, developed for the treatment of cognitive impairment associated with Alzheimer’s disease and other central nervous system disorders. These drug candidates are developed and commercialized by Merck under an exclusive license, with Neuphoria eligible for milestones and royalties.

products.name: Legacy Oncology Programs (BNC101 and BNC105, licensed to partners)
products.description: A portfolio of legacy oncology assets, including BNC101 (a monoclonal antibody targeting LGR5 for solid tumors, now licensed to Carina Biotech for CAR-T therapy development) and BNC105 (a vascular tubulin polymerization inhibitor for cancer). These programs are advanced through external partnerships and out-licensing, with Neuphoria receiving milestones and royalties.

products.name: Early-Stage CNS Ion Channel Modulator Programs
products.description: Preclinical and discovery-stage small molecule programs targeting ion channels, including next-generation α7 receptor negative allosteric modulators and Kv3.1/3.2 potassium channel activators, for potential treatment of CNS disorders such as schizophrenia, autism spectrum disorders, and cognitive deficits. These assets are positioned for future clinical development or partnering.

products.name: Refined Petroleum Products
products.description: Production and sale of gasoline, diesel fuel (including ULSD), jet fuel, and heating oil through large-scale physical refining at six U.S. refineries. Products are distributed via pipelines, marine terminals, and truck racks to wholesale customers in the U.S., Canada, Mexico, and international markets.

products.name: Petrochemical Feedstocks and Petrochemicals
products.description: Manufacture and sale of petrochemical feedstocks and high-value petrochemicals (e.g., benzene, toluene, xylene, nonene, tetramer) as byproducts of the refining process, delivered primarily by rail and pipeline to industrial customers.

products.name: Lubricants and Base Oils
products.description: Production and sale of Group I base oils and lubricants, primarily manufactured at the Paulsboro refinery, delivered to customers via pipeline, barge, or truck.

products.name: Asphalt
products.description: Production and sale of asphalt as a byproduct of the refining process, primarily at the Paulsboro refinery, distributed to customers via pipeline, barge, or truck.

products.name: Renewable Diesel
products.description: Production and sale of renewable diesel at the Renewable Diesel Facility co-located at the Chalmette refinery, using a repurposed hydrocracker and pre-treatment unit, distributed to wholesale customers.

products.name: Logistics Services (Terminals, Pipelines, Storage)
products.description: Provision of third-party logistics services including receiving, handling, storage, and transfer of crude oil, refined products, natural gas, and intermediates via owned or leased terminals, pipelines, and storage facilities across the U.S. and Canada.

products.name: Performance Advertising Platform
products.description: A proprietary AI-powered platform (including Realize) that enables advertisers to run performance-driven ad campaigns across a network of digital properties outside of search and social media. Delivered as a digital SaaS platform with advanced targeting, creative tools, and real-time analytics.

products.name: Digital Property Monetization Solutions
products.description: Technology and services that enable digital publishers to monetize their content by displaying relevant ads and product listings, sharing in revenue generated from user engagement. Delivered via direct integration with publisher sites, supporting multiple ad formats and placements.

products.name: Audience Development and Content Recommendation Platform
products.description: AI-driven recommendation engine and tools (including Taboola Newsroom) that help digital properties increase user engagement, grow audiences, and optimize editorial strategies by recommending personalized editorial and sponsored content. Delivered as a digital platform integrated into publisher sites and apps.

products.name: E-Commerce Content and Monetization Solutions
products.description: Solutions (via Connexity subsidiary) that provide publishers with access to structured product listings and enable monetization through cost-per-click or cost-per-action models when users engage with embedded product content. Includes analytics dashboards and editorial tools for commerce content.

products.name: Self-Service Advertising Platform
products.description: A digital self-service platform that allows advertisers to independently launch, manage, and optimize ad campaigns across Taboola’s network, with access to targeting, creative, and analytics tools. Delivered as a web-based SaaS product.

products.name: Brokerage Services
products.description: Provides full-feature brokerage accounts enabling trading in equities, fixed income, options, futures, forex, and cash management, delivered via digital platforms, branches, and phone support.

products.name: Banking Services
products.description: Offers checking and savings accounts, residential mortgage loans, home equity lines of credit, and pledged asset lines, delivered through regulated banking subsidiaries and digital channels.

products.name: Asset Management Products
products.description: Provides proprietary and third-party mutual funds and ETFs, including money market funds, through digital platforms and advisor channels, requiring asset management expertise and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Managed Investing Solutions
products.description: Delivers managed portfolios, including proprietary and third-party mutual funds and ETFs, separately managed accounts, and customized portfolio management, via digital and advisor-assisted models.

products.name: Custody and Support Services for Independent Advisors (RIA Custody)
products.description: Provides custodial, trading, banking, trust, and technology support services to independent registered investment advisors, leveraging proprietary and integrated third-party digital platforms.

products.name: Retirement Plan Services
products.description: Offers bundled retirement plan products, recordkeeping, trustee or custodial services, and participant-level services for employers and retirement plan sponsors, delivered via digital and consultative channels.

products.name: Stock Plan Services
products.description: Provides stock plan administration, recordkeeping, participant support, and compliance services for employer equity compensation plans, including solutions for private companies.

products.name: Alternative Investments Platform
products.description: Provides access to third-party alternative investments such as private equity and real estate through digital investment platforms, requiring due diligence and regulatory oversight.

products.name: Digital Assets and Cryptocurrency Products
products.description: Offers cryptocurrency exchange-traded products, options, futures, and plans to expand direct cryptocurrency access, delivered via digital trading platforms and subject to evolving regulation.

products.name: Trust Services
products.description: Provides trust custody, personal trust reporting, and administrative trustee services to individuals and institutions, delivered through regulated trust bank subsidiaries.

products.name: Mutual Fund Clearing and Off-Platform Sales
products.description: Offers mutual fund trading, settlement, and related transactional services to banks, brokerages, and trust companies, as well as sales of proprietary funds outside Schwab’s platform.

products.name: Designated Brokerage Compliance Services
products.description: Provides employee brokerage account surveillance, trading data feeds, and compliance monitoring solutions for employers and regulated companies, combining technology and consultative support.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: A suite of lending products for small and medium-sized businesses, including commercial real estate loans (owner-occupied and investment), construction and development loans, business term loans, equipment financing, and lines of credit. These are originated and serviced through in-person relationship management and require significant underwriting, risk management, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: A limited portfolio of consumer loans, including loans to finance insurance premiums, overdraft lines of credit, and personal loans to high net worth individuals. These are underwritten based on borrower financial condition and may be secured or unsecured, but are not a material focus of the business.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Traditional depository products for individuals and businesses, including checking, savings, money market, and certificates of deposit, delivered through physical branches and online channels. These deposits are FDIC-insured and form the primary funding source for the bank's lending activities.

products.name: Investment Securities Portfolio
products.description: Management of an investment portfolio primarily for liquidity and earnings, consisting of government agency securities, mortgage-backed securities, highly rated corporate bonds, and municipal securities. These are managed by the bank's accounting department and are not directly sold to customers but support the bank's financial operations.

products.name: GitLab DevSecOps Platform
products.description: A unified, intelligent orchestration platform that spans the entire software development lifecycle, integrating planning, development, security, compliance, testing, deployment, and operations. Delivered as a cloud-hosted SaaS, self-managed, or dedicated instance, it is built on a single codebase and open-core model, requiring digital infrastructure and software engineering expertise.

products.name: GitLab Duo Agent Platform (AI-Powered DevSecOps Automation)
products.description: An AI-powered extension of the GitLab platform that enables orchestration of AI agents to automate tasks across planning, development, security, and deployment. Delivered as a digital service, available via usage-based or seat-based pricing, and requires advanced software and AI infrastructure.

products.name: GitLab Duo Pro and Duo Enterprise (AI Developer Productivity Tools)
products.description: AI-powered developer tools for code completion, generation, chat, explanation, refactoring, test generation, security vulnerability analysis, and pipeline root cause analysis. Delivered as digital add-ons to the GitLab platform, available via seat-based subscriptions.

products.name: Enterprise Agile Planning Add-On
products.description: An add-on for advanced agile project management and planning, integrated into the GitLab platform for enterprise customers. Delivered digitally and requires software integration with the core platform.

products.name: Interactive Display Solutions
products.description: Includes interactive flat-panel displays, interactive whiteboards, and non-interactive flat-panel displays (under Mimio and Clevertouch brands) for education, corporate, and government sectors. These are manufactured via ODM/OEM partners and distributed globally, often bundled with proprietary software and professional development modules.

products.name: Digital Signage Solutions
products.description: Digital signage displays and management platforms (CleverLive, Mimio DS Series, CL Totem, CM Series) for schools, enterprises, and public spaces. These solutions include hardware and cloud-based software for content management, scheduling, and emergency messaging, and are manufactured and distributed globally.

products.name: Classroom Audio and Campus Communication Systems
products.description: Audio amplification and IP-based communication systems (FrontRow Juno, EzRoom, UNITY, Lyrik, Conductor, Symphony) for classroom and campus-wide use. These systems are manufactured and integrated with software for bells, paging, intercom, and emergency alerts, supporting both classroom and district-wide communication needs.

products.name: STEM Products and Solutions
products.description: A portfolio of STEM (science, technology, engineering, and math) products including 3D printers (Robo3D), robotics kits, and standards-driven lesson plans (MyStemKits) for K-12 education. These are developed, manufactured, and distributed globally, often bundled with curriculum content and accessories.

products.name: Educational Software Platforms
products.description: A suite of proprietary educational software (MimioStudio, MimioMobile, OKTOPUS, MyClass, LYNX Whiteboard, Notes+, GameZones) for lesson creation, interactive instruction, assessment, collaboration, and classroom management. Delivered as digital products, often bundled with hardware, and integrated with major LMS platforms.

products.name: Professional Development and Training Services
products.description: Professional training, educator certification, and technology integration services (EOS Education) for schools and districts. Delivered in-person or virtually, these services are customized to client needs and focus on effective use of Boxlight hardware and software in educational settings.

products.name: Peripherals and Accessories
products.description: A range of peripherals and accessories (cameras, media players, mobile carts, wall mounts, OPS PC modules, sensors) designed to complement and extend the functionality of Boxlight’s interactive displays and audio solutions. These are manufactured and distributed globally as add-ons to core product lines.

products.name: Self-Storage Building Solutions
products.description: Turn-key manufacturing and supply of self-storage facility components, including roll-up and swing doors, hallway systems, single- and multi-story steel buildings, and relocatable storage units, produced in company-owned manufacturing facilities and delivered as integrated solutions.

products.name: Self-Storage Facility Automation and Access Control Solutions
products.description: Development and sale of proprietary electronic locks, smart entry systems, and integrated software platforms for self-storage facility access control, including hardware, applications, web portals, and cloud-based management, delivered as digital and physical products.

products.name: Self-Storage Facility Restoration, Rebuilding, and Replacement (R3) Services
products.description: Provision of restoration, rebuilding, and replacement services for aging or acquired self-storage facilities, including project management, site planning, and installation, delivered through a network of third-party installers and company-managed teams.

products.name: Commercial and Industrial Metal Doors
products.description: Manufacture and supply of metal commercial doors, including roll-up sheet doors and rolling steel doors, for industrial, office, retail, lodging, and institutional buildings, produced in company facilities and distributed to commercial customers.

products.name: Trucking Terminal Renovation, Construction, and Maintenance Services
products.description: Design, renovation, construction, remodeling, and maintenance services for trucking terminals and related non-residential infrastructure, delivered through acquired subsidiaries and specialized project teams.

products.name: Lighting Solutions
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and sells luminaires and lighting systems, including both indoor and outdoor fixtures, for new construction, renovation, and maintenance applications. Products are physically manufactured and distributed through a network of sales agencies, distributors, and retailers.

products.name: Lighting Controls and Electronics
products.description: Provides advanced lighting controls, drivers, and connectivity platforms that integrate with lighting systems to enable automation, energy efficiency, and enhanced functionality. These are manufactured products delivered as part of lighting solutions or as standalone systems.

products.name: Building Management Systems (BMS)
products.description: Develops and sells intelligent building management systems that integrate controls, sensors, and software for managing HVAC, lighting, shades, refrigeration, and building access. Delivered as a combination of hardware and software, often installed and integrated by system integrators.

products.name: Spatial Intelligence and Building Performance Software
products.description: Offers cloud-based data platforms and applications that provide spatial intelligence, building performance analytics, and energy data management to maximize occupant and owner experiences. Delivered digitally via cloud applications and platforms.

products.name: Audio, Video, and Control Platforms
products.description: Provides full-stack audio, video, and control platforms, including hardware and software, for real-time action, experiences, and insights in commercial and entertainment spaces. Products are manufactured and delivered through system integrators to end users such as live entertainers and sound professionals.

products.name: Portland Cement and Cementitious Products
products.description: Manufactured at company-owned plants using mined limestone and other raw materials, this includes portland cement, slag cement, and fly ash, which are distributed via a network of terminals and sold primarily for use in public infrastructure, nonresidential, and residential construction. Production involves large-scale, regulated, energy-intensive processes and regional distribution.

products.name: Readymix Concrete
products.description: Produced at company-owned batch plants by mixing cement, aggregates, and water, then delivered to construction sites via mixer trucks. Operations are regional, with plants located in central Texas, Kansas City, northern Colorado, and northern Nevada, serving local construction markets.

products.name: Construction Aggregates
products.description: Crushed stone, sand, and gravel mined and processed at company-owned or leased quarries, then sold to contractors and other customers for use in construction. Aggregates are distributed locally due to high transportation costs and are used both internally and sold externally.

products.name: Gypsum Wallboard
products.description: Manufactured at company-owned plants using mined or synthetic gypsum and recycled paper, this product is used for finishing interior walls and ceilings in residential, commercial, and industrial buildings. Distribution is regional, with delivery by truck and some rail, and production is closely tied to construction cycles.

products.name: Recycled Paperboard
products.description: Produced at a dedicated facility using 100% recycled paper fiber, this paperboard is primarily used as facing paper for gypsum wallboard, but also sold to other wallboard manufacturers and for industrial uses. The process is capital- and energy-intensive, involving advanced paper machines and water treatment.

products.name: Silicon-Anode Lithium-Ion Batteries for Smartphones
products.description: High-performance lithium-ion batteries featuring proprietary 100% active silicon-anode architecture, designed and manufactured for smartphones requiring high energy density, fast charging, and safety. Produced using advanced stacking and constraint systems in high-volume manufacturing facilities.

products.name: Silicon-Anode Lithium-Ion Batteries for Smart Eyewear and Wearables
products.description: Custom and standard lithium-ion batteries with silicon-anode architecture, manufactured for smart eyewear, wearables, and IoT devices, emphasizing compact form factors, high energy density, and design flexibility. Delivered as battery cells or packs to OEMs and ODMs.

products.name: Lithium-Ion Batteries for Defense and Industrial Applications
products.description: High-power, ruggedized lithium-ion battery cells and packs, including silicon-anode and silicon-doped graphite solutions, designed for defense, industrial, and mission-critical equipment such as drones, soldier-worn systems, and public safety devices. Manufactured in vertically integrated facilities with custom and standard options.

products.name: Lithium-Ion Batteries for IoT and Medical Devices
products.description: Conventional and advanced lithium-ion batteries, including rechargeable coin cells (Power Disk series), flexible and asymmetric polymer batteries, designed for IoT, medical devices, health/wellness devices, and computing accessories. Manufactured using encapsulation and Z-Folding technologies for compact, safe, and flexible applications.

products.name: Lithium-Ion Batteries for Computing Devices
products.description: High energy density lithium-ion batteries, including silicon-anode variants, designed for portable computing devices such as laptops and tablets, supporting high performance, long runtime, and advanced features like AI workloads. Produced using proprietary manufacturing processes for OEMs.

products.name: Lithium-Ion Batteries for Electric Vehicles (EVs)
products.description: Advanced lithium-ion batteries, leveraging proprietary electrode orientation and silicon-anode technology, targeted for electric vehicle applications requiring high energy density and fast charging. Still under development and not yet a primary revenue driver.

products.name: Freeze-Dried Candy
products.description: Freeze-dried versions of familiar gummy, chewy, and hard candies transformed into crunchy snack formats with concentrated flavor and expanded texture. Products are manufactured by third parties and distributed under the Sow Good Candy brand through retail and distributor channels.

products.name: Freeze-Dried Snack Products (Non-Candy)
products.description: Freeze-dried snack concepts other than candy, developed and marketed under the Sow Good brand. These products are manufactured and packaged by third parties and distributed through retail and distributor channels. Includes snacks under development beyond the core candy line.

products.name: GLSI-100 (GP2 + GM-CSF Immunotherapy)
products.description: A biologic immunotherapy product candidate composed of the GP2 peptide and GM-CSF, administered via intradermal injection to stimulate a targeted immune response against HER2/neu-expressing cancers, primarily for the prevention of breast cancer recurrence. It is produced through peptide synthesis and recombinant protein manufacturing, and delivered as a series of injections following standard cancer therapies.

products.name: Retail Banking Services
products.description: Provides consumer deposit accounts, personal loans, debit cards, and related banking services through physical branches and ATMs. Delivery requires regulated infrastructure, physical locations, and digital banking systems.

products.name: Corporate Banking Services
products.description: Offers business deposit accounts, commercial loans, treasury management, and related services to corporate clients, delivered via relationship managers and digital platforms, requiring regulated financial capital and compliance.

products.name: Mortgage Banking
products.description: Provides residential mortgage loans, including specialized products for low- and moderate-income borrowers, delivered through loan officers and digital channels, requiring regulatory compliance and underwriting.

products.name: Trust and Investment Services
products.description: Offers personal and corporate trust administration, estate planning, and investment management, delivered by fiduciary professionals and digital platforms, requiring regulatory oversight and specialized expertise.

products.name: Brokerage Services
products.description: Provides securities brokerage, investment advisory, and discount brokerage services to retail and institutional clients, delivered through registered representatives and digital trading platforms, regulated by the SEC and FINRA.

products.name: Insurance Services
products.description: Offers property, casualty, life, and title insurance products, as well as benefit plan sales and administration for personal and commercial clients, delivered through licensed agents and digital channels.

products.name: Mutual Funds and Investment Advisory
products.description: Manages and advises a family of proprietary mutual funds (WesMark Funds) and provides investment advisory services, delivered by investment professionals and digital platforms, requiring SEC registration and compliance.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Leasing
products.description: Leases commercial real estate properties to third parties, requiring ownership and management of physical properties and tenant relationships.

products.name: Community Development Lending and Programs
products.description: Provides specialized loans and financial programs for community development, affordable housing, and small businesses in underserved areas, delivered through dedicated staff and partnerships with non-profits and government entities.

products.name: Fine Jewelry
products.description: A broad assortment of fine jewelry, including diamond, gold, silver, and gemstone pieces, sold through physical retail stores and online platforms. Products are sourced from third-party manufacturers and include both branded and non-branded merchandise.

products.name: Bridal Jewelry
products.description: Engagement rings, wedding bands, and anniversary jewelry, predominantly featuring diamonds, offered through both in-store and online channels. Includes both natural and lab-grown diamond options, with a significant focus on the bridal category across brands.

products.name: Fashion Jewelry
products.description: Fashion-oriented jewelry collections, including gold, silver, and diamond pieces, designed for everyday wear and trend-focused customers. Sold through mall-based kiosks, stores, and online, with curated assortments and proprietary collections.

products.name: Watches
products.description: A selection of fine watches, including both branded and non-branded timepieces, offered as part of the jewelry assortment in stores and online, with a higher concentration in international markets.

products.name: Loose Diamonds (Natural and Lab-Grown)
products.description: Loose polished and rough diamonds, both natural and lab-grown, sourced, cut, and polished by Signet or third parties, sold directly to customers for custom jewelry or as standalone stones.

products.name: Custom Jewelry Design Services
products.description: Custom jewelry design services provided in-store and through centralized service centers, utilizing proprietary computer systems and skilled artisans to create personalized pieces for customers.

products.name: Jewelry Repair Services
products.description: Repair services for jewelry, including ring sizing, refinishing, polishing, rhodium plating, earring repair, chain soldering, engraving, and resetting of stones, provided in-store and through centralized facilities.

products.name: Jewelry Subscription Services
products.description: Jewelry rental and subscription services, previously operated as Rocksbox and now integrated as proprietary collections within other brands, allowing customers to access and exchange fashion jewelry for a recurring fee.

products.name: Piercing Services
products.description: Professional ear and facial piercing services offered primarily through Banter by Piercing Pagoda mall-based kiosks and select stores, including the use of hollow needle techniques in select markets.

products.name: Extended Service Plans and Jewelry Replacement Plans
products.description: Extended service plans covering lifetime repair services for jewelry and watches, as well as jewelry replacement plans, sold alongside merchandise and providing coverage for repairs, maintenance, and replacements.

products.name: Acute Inpatient Psychiatric Services
products.description: High-acuity, facility-based psychiatric care for patients who are a threat to themselves or others, delivered in hospital settings with 24-hour observation and intervention by psychiatrists and trained staff. Services include evaluation, crisis stabilization, and intensive medical and behavioral therapies.

products.name: Specialty Treatment Services for Addictive and Co-Occurring Disorders
products.description: Comprehensive facility-based and outpatient treatment for adults with substance use disorders and co-occurring mental health conditions, including detoxification, inpatient, partial hospitalization, outpatient, and extended care programs. Services are individualized and may include medication-assisted treatment, counseling, and group therapy.

products.name: Comprehensive Treatment Centers (CTCs) for Opioid Use Disorder
products.description: Outpatient medication-assisted treatment centers specializing in opioid addiction, combining behavioral therapy and medication management. Services include medication dispensing, individual and group therapy, peer support, and social services, typically delivered over a year or more.

products.name: Residential Treatment Services for Behavioral Disorders
products.description: Non-hospital, facility-based residential care for children, adolescents, and adults with behavioral health disorders, providing intensive, medically-driven interventions, therapy, and accredited educational programs in secure or unlocked environments. Includes group homes and therapeutic group homes for youths.

products.name: Intellectual Property Licensing for Retail Engagement Technologies
products.description: Licensing of proprietary patents covering real-time consumer behavior monitoring, analytics, personalized marketing, digital engagement, inventory management, and in-store assistance systems to retailers, brands, and technology providers. Delivered through structured agreements and enforcement actions, this is an IP-driven, asset-light business line.

products.name: AI-Driven Retail Analytics and Engagement Solutions
products.description: Deployment of AI-powered software and systems for real-time consumer analytics, targeted in-store marketing, dynamic digital displays, smart planograms, and inventory optimization. Delivered via software platforms, integrations, and hardware (kiosks, displays) in partnership with retailers and technology integrators.

products.name: Retail Financial Services Platform (Alpha Cash)
products.description: Provision of financial and payment-related services (check cashing, money transfer, bill payment, prepaid products, event ticketing) to underbanked and convenience-oriented consumers via proprietary mobile and in-store kiosk platforms, integrated with compliance and banking partners. Requires regulated infrastructure and partnerships with sponsor banks and payment processors.

products.name: Retail Technology Consulting and Implementation Services
products.description: Consulting, solution design, implementation support, maintenance, monitoring, and data analytics services to assist customers and partners in deploying AI-enabled retail applications and analytics-driven engagement systems. Delivered through in-person and remote professional services engagements.

products.name: Large-Scale Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) EPC Services
products.description: Engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) services for large-scale battery energy storage systems, integrating batteries, power conversion systems, and energy management systems for commercial and utility customers. Delivery involves project management, technical design, procurement of hardware, and on-site construction and installation.

products.name: Residential and Small Business Solar and Battery System Installation
products.description: Design, sale, and installation of photovoltaic solar energy systems and battery backup systems for residential and small business customers, primarily in California. Delivery includes feasibility assessment, system design, permitting, procurement, installation, and post-installation maintenance.

products.name: Commercial LED Lighting Projects
products.description: Provision and installation of LED lighting systems for commercial and governmental customers, including energy audits, system design, procurement, and installation. Some projects involve third-party installers or customer self-installation.

products.name: Legacy Solar Project EPC and Development Services (China)
products.description: Engineering, procurement, and construction services for large solar farm projects in China, including project identification, procurement, resale to third-party developers, and related services. No current operations, but historically significant.

products.name: Solar System Financing (Legacy Portfolio)
products.description: Provision of secured installment financing for purchasers of residential and commercial photovoltaic systems, with ongoing servicing of an existing loan portfolio. No new loans since 2022; revenue is from legacy receivables.

products.name: Solar System Leasing and Power Purchase Agreements (Legacy Portfolio)
products.description: Ownership and maintenance of solar energy systems under existing operating leases and power purchase agreements, primarily for commercial customers. No new leases since 2014; revenue is from legacy contracts.

products.name: Community Banking Services
products.description: Provides a full range of traditional banking products and services, including deposit accounts and lending solutions, to individual and commercial customers through a network of physical branches. Delivery requires regulated infrastructure, financial capital, and in-person and digital customer service.

products.name: Wealth Management and Investment Advisory Services
products.description: Offers wealth management, trust, and investment advisory services to customers through a dedicated Trust Division and a wholly owned wealth management subsidiary. Delivery involves licensed professionals and regulated financial advisory infrastructure.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides a range of business loans including construction and land development loans, commercial real estate loans, and commercial and industrial loans to small and medium-sized businesses. These loans are typically secured by real estate or business assets and require in-person underwriting and ongoing relationship management.

products.name: Small Business Administration (SBA) Lending
products.description: Offers SBA 7(a) and SBA 504 loans, which are partially guaranteed by the U.S. government, to small businesses for purposes such as real estate purchase, refinancing, and equipment needs. These loans are originated, sometimes sold in the secondary market, and require compliance with federal lending standards.

products.name: Deposit Products
products.description: Provides a variety of deposit accounts including demand, money market, certificates of deposit, and time deposits to businesses and individuals. These are delivered through physical branches and digital channels, and are FDIC insured.

products.name: Treasury Management Services
products.description: Offers treasury management solutions such as online banking, remote deposit capture, ACH origination, cash vault, sweep accounts, and lockbox processing to business clients. These services are delivered digitally and through branch locations to help clients manage cash flow and payments.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Provides consumer loans including secured and unsecured installment loans, revolving lines of credit, and home equity lines of credit (HELOCs) to individuals. These loans are underwritten based on creditworthiness and collateral, and may include specialized products such as solar panel loans.

products.name: Investment Securities
products.description: Invests in and manages a portfolio of debt securities including agency securities, municipal bonds, mortgage-backed securities, collateralized mortgage obligations, SBA loan pool securities, and U.S. Treasury securities. These are held for investment or liquidity purposes and not directly sold to customers.

products.name: Seaborne Drybulk Transportation Services
products.description: Transportation of a wide variety of drybulk cargoes (e.g., grains, coal, iron ore, bauxite, cement clinker, limestone) using a fleet of owned and chartered ocean-going vessels. Services are delivered globally and require physical vessels, technical management, and compliance with international shipping regulations.

products.name: Port, Terminal, and Stevedoring Services
products.description: Provision of cargo loading, discharge, and port and terminal operations for vessel and cargo owners. These services involve in-person labor, regulated port infrastructure, and specialized equipment at ports.

products.name: Ice-Class Vessel Transportation Services
products.description: Specialized drybulk transportation services using Ice-Class 1A and 1C vessels capable of operating in ice-restricted areas such as the Baltic Sea, Gulf of St. Lawrence, and Arctic Ocean. Requires investment in specialized ships and expertise in harsh environments.

products.name: Comprehensive Drybulk Logistics Solutions
products.description: Integrated logistics solutions for industrial customers, including scheduling, voyage planning, cargo handling, and supply chain optimization. Delivered through a combination of digital planning, in-person management, and physical transportation assets.
